roles.title: Computer Vision Researcher
roles.summary: Designed and trained a two-stage crater detection and segmentation pipeline on Chandrayaan-2 terrain-model (DTM) imagery. It reaches 0.83 mIoU on lunar crater tiles.

roles.title: Software Engineering Intern
roles.summary: Built XGBoost price-forecasting models for non-perishable commodities across the APMC markets of Gujarat. They beat the seasonal-naive baseline by 40% on held-out seasons. I also developed procurement-timing signals for 20 collection centers, and shipped a daily pipeline that ingests arrivals and prices for 200+ commodity-market pairs.
